description: This file defines a React functional component 'RemoteImageComponent' that displays an image and optionally a save button; it manages image fetch/upload logic, interacts with application controller for file upload and linking, and handles image load state.

classes.name: RemoteImageComponent
classes.description: A React component that renders an image with optional save button, managing image upload process and interaction with application controllers.

methods.name: fetchAndUploadImage
methods.description: Handles fetching the image from source, uploading it as a file, replacing the node with a file node, and linking the uploaded file to the selected item.
